findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
1) Vertical trim piece observed missing on the corner near the meat room chicken station handsink.
2) Wall in the meat room walk-in cooler observed to be damaged near the swinging doors to the meat room. 
Repair and maintain physical facilities in good condition.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.citation_text:
5-205.15 Hot water would not shut off at the meat department 3 part sink by use of the hot water handle. The lever that switched between free flowing water from the faucet and use of the sprayer allowed for shut off, but hot water will still run constantly and potentially impact the cold water when used. Provide proper repairs so both the hot and cold water shut off via the faucet handles. 
A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. A work order will be placed for the abovementioned plumbing issue to be repaired.
